core_memory.user_gym: I started going to the gym regularly in college to balance out my sedentary coding lifestyle. It's helped me physically and mentally, giving me more energy, improving my mood, and enhancing my productivity. It's a great stress-reliever after long coding sessions and helps me sleep better at night.
